name: Extract Secret
description: Reveal one of your own secrets through a direct result-only run, requiring secret/extract on s/NAME. Recorded jobs, MCP tools, agents, sessions and nested operation calls are refused. Use the published definition unchanged. Any run that would record a job fails closed. Prefer s/ references for integrations; never put the returned plaintext in prompts, history, logs or durable configuration. Not included in the agent secrets skill.

name.description: Exact single secret name in your own store, not a path.
